snapshot.what: full-database snapshot of a public register of AI harms
snapshot.licence: Database shared under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); report contents are subject to their own intellectual property rights, per the snapshot's own license.txt
snapshot.not_committed: The 105 MB snapshot is not committed to this repository. It is pinned by SHA-256 and re-downloadable from the URL above; every script here verifies the hash before reading a field.

third_party_text.rule: The register's stored full-text copies of third-party documents are never written into this repository.
third_party_text.what_is_committed_instead: A one-way fingerprint per sampled report: sha1-derived hashes of 8-word shingles of the normalised text. The text cannot be reconstructed from them; a live page can still be scored against them.

runtime.third_party_packages: none for the offline layer; the live probe uses one HTTP client library
runtime.vantage: datacenter address behind a forward proxy — not a reader's browser
